title: Diagonal normalization of the explicit graph comparison
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X→Y any morphism of schemes, and c=(i:X→C,g:C→Y) an open-then-proper compactification. For the explicit graph map B(c,ofCompactification(c)) of [def-pur-etale-graph-presentation-maps], B(c,ofCompactification(c)) equals the inverse of the canonical isomorphism removing R(id_X)_* from the presentation word. No quasi-compactness or Noetherianity is assumed.

source.place: Diagonal normalization of the explicit graph comparison; Tags 0F7B--0F7F and the explicit graph formula in LowerShriekComposition.lean:193--268. Agent specialization/pasting argument, not a claim that the upstream file states this equality.

proof.text: Use a proof-only import all of UnboundedEtaleCompactSupportComparisons to reuse its existing private unboundedFormalism and unbounded_refinement_comparison. The latter identifies the formalism comparison with the specified unbounded comparison for arbitrary schemes and coefficients. Specialize it to Compactification.Refinement.id c with IsPullback.id_vert c.i and apply the existing CompactSupportFormalism.refinementComparison_eq_id. Thus the specified identity refinement comparison equals the identity. No formalism construction, derived coherence lemma or mate proof is copied.

Apply the single-refinement graph normalization to this identity refinement and Cartesian identity square. Convert the proved identity of natural transformations to an identity of asIso isomorphisms by Iso.ext, substitute it, and remove the identity isomorphism. This proves B(c,c)=openNormalization(c) inverse.

    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) :
    etaleGraphComparisonFromOpen A c (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification c) =
      (etaleGraphOpenNormalization A c).symm
